Hi Alex / Marissa —

Thanks — I can own the security intake. High-level answers below and we'll provide a completed questionnaire attachment within 3 business days.

Telemetry & logging boundaries:
- Dedicated / Private: customer compute and KV caches run inside the customer's VPC or on-prem cluster. Control plane metadata (billing, orchestration events) is separated and can be redacted; we can disable model telemetry and opt you out of analytics at the account level as part of the contract.
- We can commit that model inputs and outputs (raw PHI) will not be used for model training or analytics when the BAA is in place; operational logs that include identifiers can be configured to be masked or not retained beyond contractually agreed retention windows.

Disabling telemetry:
- There is an account-level toggle that prevents ingestion of prompts/outputs into analytics. For Dedicated we offer a stricter mode that also masks token-level logs in the control plane. We'll include implementation details in the questionnaire.

Provisioning lead time / throughput:
- Average Dedicated provisioning (networking + infra + security review): 4–6 weeks from signed order; expedited paths available with a paid implementation engagement.
- For ~50 QPS short sequences we recommend a 4-GPU reserved pool (with autoscale policy for burst) as a starting point. We'll provide a more exact cost ballpark in the questionnaire; rough estimate: $XXk–$YYk/month depending on instance family and commitment term.

Attachments I'll include: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (SOC 2 report) and Redwood_BAA_Draft_2026.docx (editable BAA).

Next steps:

- Propose a 60-min security deep-dive next week to go over the SOC2 and BAA items; I'll bring our infra/security engineer.
